content: Hi, I've been trying to reset my password for the past hour and I'm not getting any email. I have a presentation in 2 hours and I really need access to my account. This is extremely frustrating.

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry you're experiencing this issue, especially with a deadline approaching. Let me help you get this resolved quickly. Can you confirm the email address associated with your account?
It's sarah.chen@techcorp.com. I've checked my spam folder too, nothing there. I've tried resetting 3 times already.

Thank you for confirming, Sarah. I can see your account here. Let me check the email delivery status on our end. It looks like the reset emails were sent but may have been blocked by your company's email filter. I'm going to manually send you a reset link right now to a personal email. Could you provide an alternate email address?
Yes, sarahchen@gmail.com. Thank you, that would be really helpful.

Perfect. I've sent the reset link to sarahchen@gmail.com. You should receive it within the next 2 minutes. The link will be valid for 24 hours. Once you reset your password, you should have full access to your account. I'm also going to unlock your account immediately since it was locked due to the multiple failed attempts.
Got it! I just received the email and reset my password. I'm back in my account now. Thank you so much for the quick help.
Excellent! I'm glad we got you back in. For your presentation, all your data is intact and accessible. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. You were really helpful. I'll make sure to add the personal email as a backup. Thanks again!

You're welcome, Sarah! That's a great idea to add a backup email. You can do that in Settings > Account > Security > Backup Email. Good luck with your presentation, and don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything else. Have a great day!
